name: Button
summary: Trigger an action or navigation — the primary interactive control.
highlights: Also the dismiss ✕: tertiary icon-only at size xs
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-button> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens, so every button reads identically across apps and even outside one. Variants and sizes are attributes; there is one rendered UI, not a per-framework look-alike.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue consumes the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Sizes
spec.value: xs 20 (icon-only only, r6) · sm 28 (r4) · md 36 (r8) · lg 40 (r8, default) · xl 52 (r12, padding 28) · touch 48 (r8, padding 24) — heights; fontSize 14 (sm/md) / 16 (lg/xl/touch)

spec.label: Wrap
spec.value: `wrap` on sizes sm / md / lg / xl / touch: height auto with min-height the size's own height (28 / 36 / 40 / 52 / 48), 8px block padding (4px on sm), line height 1.25, centred text, white-space normal, overflow-wrap break-word, host max-width 100%; icon, spinner and shortcut chip keep their size and stay centred; a one-line label is the same height as without wrap; ignored by icon-only and size inline

spec.label: Primary
spec.value: bg #E70E68, label #FFFFFF, hover #DB005B + soft pink shadow, active #DB005B without the hover shadow

spec.label: Secondary
spec.value: white bg, #1A1A1A label, 1px #E3E3E3 border; hover pale pink #E70E680D fill laid over the button's own opaque fill (white), so it never shows the surface through, #E70E68 border and #DB005B label (--aha-text-link-hover, 4.66:1); active #E70E680D fill, #DB005B border (--aha-border-active), #DB005B label; disabled shows no hover or press change; focus ring unchanged

spec.label: Tertiary / Link
spec.value: transparent; tertiary rest label #1A1A1A, no border; hover and active #E70E680D fill with #DB005B label (--aha-text-link-hover, 4.66:1), no border so no border change; link #E70E68 weight 400, underlined at rest and on hover (the text-link variant is not: see Text / Text-link), hover #DB005B; the component cannot see its surface, so on a surface other than white the screen sets --aha-text-link and --aha-text-link-hover to the default ink #1A1A1A on that container (white on a dark surface), since pink fails 4.5:1 there

spec.label: Danger
spec.value: renders exactly as secondary in every state (white fill, 1px #E3E3E3 border, #1A1A1A label; hover #E70E680D fill with a #E70E68 border; active #DB005B border) — a destructive action; the variant name is kept so callers do not break; never the primary button, the safe choice beside it is

spec.label: Positive
spec.value: Vivid Pink like primary: bg #E70E68, white label, hover #DB005B + soft pink shadow, active #DB005B — Upgrade and other encouraging actions

spec.label: Primary-alt
spec.value: same fill as primary #E70E68 (a second primary slot for a two-primary layout)

spec.label: Secondary-deck
spec.value: white fill on every deck; edge in the dark text ink (--aha-text-default, #1A1A1A) at 10%, label that ink solid (17.4:1 on white), never the deck accent or the deck ink, which turns white on a dark deck; hover a 5% ink wash, pressed 10%, focus the same Vivid Pink ring, disabled an ink-10% edge and ink-45% label; size touch gives the 48px audience height

spec.label: Tertiary-deck
spec.value: transparent, no edge; label in the deck ink (--aha-deck-ink); hover ink 5%, pressed ink 10%, focus the same Vivid Pink ring, disabled ink 45%; size touch gives the 48px audience height

spec.label: Contextual theming
spec.value: a button on a themed surface (a survey or deck theme) takes its colours from the --aha-button-* tokens, set on the surface or any ancestor: --aha-button-primary-bg/-bg-hover/-bg-press/-text, --aha-button-focus-ring, --aha-button-focus-gap, and --aha-deck-ink for tertiary-deck. applyCanvasDeck(element, { accent, ink, background }) in lib/canvas-deck.js sets them all from a theme's accent, ink and background, the hover and press steps included; no new hue is picked by the button

spec.label: Canvas close ✕
spec.value: icon-only size sm with `corner`, a 28 × 28 square (radius 4, 16px system-x), never the 40px lg of the presenter controls. tertiary-deck: glyph in --aha-deck-ink-secondary (the deck ink at 76%) at rest, the full deck ink on a 5% ink wash on hover and a 10% wash pressed, the deck focus ring, glyph ink 45% when disabled. secondary-deck, for a ✕ directly on the photo of a photographic deck, where tertiary-deck is banned (tertiary-deck stays on a card, panel or popover with its own fill whose glyph clears 3:1 against it over the photo): the white fill, 10% dark-ink edge and dark-ink glyph of the secondary-deck button, with its 5% and 10% washes. Call applyCanvasDeck on the slide root first

spec.label: Audience close ✕
spec.value: tertiary-deck icon-only size md: a 36 × 36 square (radius 8, 16px system-x, the foundation md icon-only values), smaller than the 48 × 48 touch icon-only because a ✕ beside a modal title would dominate it; an invisible 44 × 44 hit area (4px beyond each edge of the drawn square) keeps the audience touch floor. Ink is the deck ink; on a white modal or sheet add `sheet`: --aha-icon-muted (#8A8A8A, 3.45:1 on white) at rest, text-default (#1A1A1A) with a --aha-bg-hover fill on hover and press, --aha-button-disabled-text when disabled

spec.label: Text / Text-link
spec.value: white bg, no border, weight 400; text = secondary-grey label, hover grey fill; text-link = #DB005B label (--aha-text-link), no underline at rest, underlined on hover, press and keyboard focus (the default ink gets it back through --aha-text-link-decoration), hover #DB005B, active #DB005B (--aha-color-primary-active); for a default-ink link use tone="ink" (Text-link tone ink, below); a screen that still swaps the link to the default ink by hand also sets --aha-text-link-decoration: underline, since the underline is then the only cue (default ink on a non-white surface)

spec.label: Disabled
spec.value: bg #E3E3E3, label #B5B5B5

spec.label: Shortcut chip
spec.value: `shortcut` draws the key after the label, 8px from it: 24 × 24 square, radius 4 (radius-xs), key 14px / 400 (the one exception to the 16px canvas floor); a longer key keeps the 24px height and grows with 6px side padding, 4px between a word key and the return arrow; at lg the end padding drops to 8px so the chip sits 8px in. Wash: white-label primary black 20% with a white key; black-label primary ink 10% with a black key (--aha-button-primary-shortcut-bg); every other variant the label colour at 16%. Display only and aria-hidden; fades with the label when disabled; hidden on icon-only (the tooltip carries the key). Mac glyphs (⌘ ⇧ ⌥ ⌃) or Windows words (Ctrl, Shift, Alt) follow the presenter's machine; Enter is the DS icon system-key-return

spec.label: Inline (text-link only)
spec.value: size inline: display inline, 0 padding, no border, no fill, weight 400, font and line height from the sentence, so the line stays its own height; selectable text; #DB005B label, underlined at rest because colour alone doesn't mark it in a sentence, 2px Vivid Pink ring outside a 2px gap; an <a> wraps with the sentence word by word, a <button> is one atomic box that wraps inside itself, label aligned to the start

spec.label: Text-link tone ink
spec.value: tone="ink" on variant text-link, at every size including inline: label in the default ink #1A1A1A (--aha-text-default), underlined at rest because colour no longer marks it as a link, no fill, so it sits on white, grey or Vivid Pink at 5%; hover #DB005B (--aha-text-link-hover) and press #DB005B (--aha-color-primary-active), both underlined; the same Vivid Pink focus ring; disabled exactly as the pink text-link (#B5B5B5). Ink 17.4:1 on white, 15.68:1 on grey #F3F3F3, 16.06:1 on Vivid Pink at 5% #FEF3F7; Darker Pink hover 5.04, 4.55 and 4.65:1 on the same three. Built on --aha-text-link and --aha-text-link-decoration, set on the host, so no other rule changes and the pink default renders as before

spec.label: Label / icon
spec.value: Plus Jakarta Sans SemiBold 600, 14 (sm/md) / 16 (lg/xl/touch); icon 16px, inline-flex, 8px gap

spec.label: Focus
spec.value: 2px solid outline ring (--aha-button-focus-ring) 2px outside a 2px box-shadow gap (--aha-button-focus-gap) — Vivid Pink #E70E68, 4.51:1 on white. A consumer box-shadow cannot hide the ring. Re-point --aha-button-focus-ring / --aha-button-focus-gap on a dark surface; --aha-button-focus-outline / --aha-button-focus-outline-offset re-point the outline. On a Vivid Pink (brand) surface set surface="brand": the ring turns white (--aha-white) with a Vivid Pink gap (--aha-vivid-pink-100), 4.51:1 against the pink

spec.label: Elevation
spec.value: subtle drop-shadow (primary rgba0,0,0,.04 · secondary .016)

spec.label: Icon-only
spec.value: square (width = height per size: 20/28/36/40/52), glyph centred, no label; needs aria-label

spec.label: Close (✕)
spec.value: tertiary icon-only at size xs: <aha-button variant="tertiary" icon-only size="xs" corner aria-label="Close"> holding the 16px system-x · 20 × 20 drawn, an invisible 32 × 32 hit area · radius 6 (radius-sm) · never circular (no disc, no system-x-circle as a control); over a photo it takes a white fill

spec.label: Close · colour
spec.value: muted glyph --aha-icon-muted (#8A8A8A) at rest, transparent fill; hover and press turn the glyph --aha-text-default (#1A1A1A) on a --aha-bg-hover (#F7F7F7) fill with the same 0.2s fade as every Button state; focus is the 2px Vivid Pink ring outside a 2px gap

spec.label: Close · position
spec.value: `corner`: end of the row, top-pinned, centre 2.5px above the centre of the first line of text (stays put when the text wraps); -2px end margin tucks it 2px into the container's end padding (Info box: hit area 15px from the right, 11px from the top)

spec.label: Close · used by
spec.value: Alert · Info box · Background task · Toast · Notification · Modal · Drawer · CSAT · Uploader. Toast and Notification take it through dismissibleToast / dismissibleTitle, Modal and Drawer through dismissibleModalTitle / dismissibleDrawerTitle with `closable={false}`

props.name: variant
props.type: primary | secondary | tertiary | link | danger | positive | primary-alt | text | text-link | secondary-deck | tertiary-deck
props.desc: tone × emphasis; one primary per view. Status carries no hue: danger renders as secondary and positive is Vivid Pink like primary; primary-alt is a synonym of primary; text / text-link are borderless label buttons; secondary-deck is the white-filled button with a 10% dark-ink edge and a dark-ink label on every deck, the audience phone's secondary action; tertiary-deck is the borderless, transparent button with its label in the deck ink (ink 5% hover, 10% pressed), the audience phone's tertiary action; with icon-only and size md it is the audience close ✕, with icon-only and size sm the canvas close ✕ (secondary-deck too)

props.name: size
props.type: xs | sm | md | lg | xl | touch | inline
props.desc: 20 / 28 / 36 / 40 / 52 / 48px height; inline has no height of its own, it works with variant text-link only and sits inside a sentence: 0 padding, no border, no fill, the sentence's font and line height; it draws no icon, spinner or shortcut, never use block with it; on any other variant it silently renders a 36px line, so size inline without variant text-link, or with shortcut, is a hard fail in screen-lint (inline-button) — xs (20, r6) exists for icon-only only: it is the dismiss ✕ (tertiary); sm with tertiary-deck or secondary-deck and icon-only is the canvas close ✕; lg (40) is the default and the in-canvas presenter control size; xl (52, the web-component twin of React <XLButtonScope>) is no longer the canvas size; touch (48, 8px corners, 16px label) is the audience phone's primary action and clears the 44px touch floor; md with tertiary-deck and icon-only is the audience close ✕, 36 drawn with a 44 × 44 hit area

props.name: tone
props.desc: variant text-link only, at any size including inline: ink draws the link in the default ink #1A1A1A, underlined at rest, Darker Pink #DB005B on hover and press. For a page or region with many links (link lists, footers, long articles), where a run of pink links is noisy, and for links on grey or Vivid Pink at 5%, where pink text may not sit (colour rules 6.5 and 6.6). One or two links on white stay the default pink. Ignored by every other variant

props.name: wrap
props.desc: long or translated labels go onto two or more lines and the button grows in height from the size's own height; for a label you cannot keep short, e.g. a translated action on a phone; keep labels short first. A one-line label renders exactly as without it. Ignored by icon-only and size inline (xs is icon-only only)

props.name: sheet
props.desc: tertiary-deck icon-only md only (the audience close ✕): set on a white modal or sheet so the glyph is muted grey (--aha-icon-muted) instead of the deck ink, which can be white on a dark deck. Text-default on hover and press

props.name: surface
props.desc: the surface the Button sits on. brand = a Vivid Pink band (a marketing hero or footer banner): keyboard focus draws a white ring (--aha-white) outside a Vivid Pink gap (--aha-vivid-pink-100) in place of the Vivid Pink ring, which would vanish on the pink. Sets --aha-button-focus-ring and --aha-button-focus-gap on the host, so a page rule on the element still wins. Changes focus only, not the fill, border or label

props.name: disabled
props.desc: non-interactive; grey fill. A disabled ancestor <fieldset> disables the Button too, as it does a native button (the Button is form-associated)

props.name: loading
props.desc: shows a spinner, blocks clicks

props.name: block
props.desc: full-width

props.name: iconOnly
props.desc: square, label-less; requires aria-label

props.name: icon
props.desc: leading glyph via <span slot="icon">; for icon-only, the glyph is the default child

props.name: icon-end
props.desc: trailing glyph after the label via <aha-icon slot="icon-end" size="16" decorative> ("Next →"); same 16px box and 8px gap as the leading icon slot; hidden on icon-only

props.name: shortcut
props.desc: display-only keyboard chip after the label: "M", "Esc", "Enter", "Shift+Enter", "Mod+Enter", "+" for a literal plus key, "Ctrl++" for Ctrl and plus (Mod = ⌘ on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere). Binds no key; aria-hidden, so put the key in the name too (aria-label="Save (Ctrl+Enter)" where the label alone does not say it). Not drawn on icon-only: give its aha-tooltip the shortcut. Updates in place when changed

props.name: href
props.desc: draws the Button as a link: renders <a href> in place of <button>, so it navigates, opens in a new tab and is crawlable (header Log in / Sign up, marketing CTAs). target and rel are forwarded. A disabled or loading Button stays a <button> and does not navigate

props.name: type
props.desc: submit submits the Button's <form> (form.requestSubmit(), so validation and the submit event run); the Button is form-associated, and Enter in a text field of that form submits it too, as with a native submit button, unless the Button is disabled or loading or a native submit button comes first. reset resets the form; any other value does nothing on click

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.desc: ids in the button's own tree, forwarded to the inner button by element reflection (ariaLabelledByElements) so the named element supplies the accessible name. Resolved when the attribute changes or the button renders

props.name: aria-disabled
props.desc: copied to the inner button, and again whenever it changes. Announces a disabled state without removing the Button from the tab order; it does not block clicks (use disabled for that)

props.name: aria-describedby
props.desc: ids in the button's own tree, forwarded to the inner button by element reflection (ariaDescribedByElements); aha-tooltip appends its hidden description node's id here so the tooltip text is announced. Resolved when the attribute changes or the button renders

props.name: aria-expanded
props.desc: state of a disclosure toggle (a Filters button that opens a panel): copied to the inner button, and again whenever it changes, so a screen reader announces expanded or collapsed. Set it on the aha-button, never on a wrapper

props.name: aria-controls
props.desc: ids of the region the button opens, forwarded to the inner button by element reflection (ariaControlsElements); resolved when the attribute changes or the button renders

props.name: aria-pressed
props.desc: state of a toggle button, copied to the inner button and kept in step when it changes

props.name: pressed
props.desc: a toggle button that is on (Bold in a toolbar, a selected filter chip): the button keeps its variant's press look (the same fill, edge and label as :active) and the inner button gets aria-pressed="true". pressed="false" is the toggle when off: aria-pressed="false" and the rest look. An aria-pressed set on the host wins over the derived value. A disabled button draws no pressed look. Off by default, so existing buttons are unchanged

props.name: aria-haspopup
props.desc: "menu", "listbox", "dialog" and so on: copied to the inner button and kept in step when it changes

props.name: aria-current
props.desc: marks the current item in a set (the active pagination dot or step): copied to the inner button and kept in step when it changes

props.name: aria-keyshortcuts, aria-roledescription, aria-description, aria-busy
props.desc: copied to the inner button and kept in step when they change, like aria-pressed, so a value set on the host is what a screen reader hears

props.name: focus()
props.desc: host.focus() moves keyboard focus to the inner button (the shadow root delegates focus). Changing variant, size, block, icon-only, loading, disabled or aria-label updates the inner button in place, so a focused button keeps focus; only a link that turns into a button (or back) is redrawn, and it takes focus with it

props.name: --aha-button-primary-shortcut-bg
props.desc: the primary's shortcut chip wash; applyCanvasDeck sets the ink at 10% under a black label

props.name: corner
props.desc: icon-only xs only: pins the ✕ to the end of a flex row, centre 2.5px above the first line's centre, 2px into the container's end padding

props.name: --aha-close-line-height
props.desc: with corner: height of the first line of text, so the ✕ centre sits 2.5px above that line's centre

props.name: --aha-close-inset
props.desc: with corner: optional fixed distance from the container's end edge, measured against --aha-close-container-padding (the container's end padding, border included), instead of the -2px corner margin

props.name: <aha-close-button>
props.desc: kept so existing code resolves (AhaCloseButton, defineAhaCloseButton, label prop); renders the xs tertiary icon-only button above. Use <aha-button> directly

whenToUse.when: the single most important action on a view (one per screen)
the default for most actions — neutral, white with a border

the audience phone, for a real but lesser action beside aha-audience-submit (the one primary): Upload photo or Change answer on a slide that also has Submit. Not for the submit itself, and not for a quiet action such as Skip (use tertiary-deck). Size touch, as text, icon + text or icon only (icon-only needs aria-label). The presenter canvas close ✕ is the one use at size sm, below

the audience phone, for a low-emphasis action that should recede behind the submit and any secondary action: Skip, Back or Remove. Not for the submit, a main side action, a link inside running text, or a button that must be found at a glance on a busy deck. Size touch, as text, icon + text or icon only (icon-only needs aria-label). The presenter canvas close ✕ is the one use at size sm, below

the audience phone, to dismiss a modal, sheet or overlay: tertiary-deck icon-only size md (36 × 36, 44 × 44 hit area, `aria-label="Close"`, 16px system-x); add `sheet` on a white surface. Not for an action (Skip, Remove, Back stay size touch)

the presenter canvas, to dismiss a panel, popover or overlay the slide draws: tertiary-deck icon-only size sm with `corner` and `aria-label="Close"` (28 × 28, not the 40px lg of the presenter controls); directly on the photo of a photographic deck, where tertiary-deck is banned, secondary-deck icon-only size sm; on a card, panel or popover with its own fill over the photo it stays tertiary-deck when its glyph clears 3:1 against that surface. Not for a presenter action (those stay lg)
low-emphasis navigation beside other controls, no container weight; never inside a sentence
a link or a toggle inside a sentence: href to navigate (<a>), no href to act on the page (<button>)

a page or region with many links (link lists, footers, long articles) where a run of pink would distract, and any link on grey or Vivid Pink at 5%: `<aha-button variant="text-link" tone="ink">`, with size inline in a sentence. One or two links on white stay pink
a destructive action (delete, remove) — pair with a confirm
an encouraging action such as Upgrade
a label you cannot keep short, such as a translated action on a phone: `<aha-button size="touch" block wrap>`. Keep labels short first; never restyle ::part(button) to wrap
a compact action where the glyph is self-explanatory (close, more, add) — always give an aria-label

any dismiss or remove ✕ — alert, info box, background task, toast, notification, modal, drawer, CSAT follow-up, uploader row: tertiary icon-only at size xs with the 16px system-x and `corner`; on the audience phone the ✕ is tertiary-deck icon-only size md instead, and on the presenter canvas tertiary-deck (secondary-deck directly on a photo deck's photo) icon-only size sm
a control drawn inside the slide canvas: see the Canvas Library › Components page (canvas/index.html) for the demo, the sizes and the rules

one main action with a caret menu of close variants beside it, joined into one shape: use <aha-split-button>, Button's split variant (the Split section of the Button page). Never join an aha-button and an aha-dropdown by hand

opinion.note: Inside a sentence the one approved form is variant text-link with size inline, in both cases. It navigates: add href, it renders a native <a href>, role link. It acts on the page (a toggle, Show more): no href, it renders a native <button>, role button, with aria-expanded and aria-controls for show and hide, or pressed for on and off. Never an <a> with a button role, never an <a> with an empty href, never variant link or size sm or xs in a sentence, because they carry a box and padding. Size inline needs variant text-link and takes no shortcut (the inline-button lint). Inside an Alert or info box message the link stays the plain <a href> that element styles (the alert-button-link lint). Pink links still sit on white only; on grey or Vivid Pink at 5%, and where a page or region has many links, the link is tone="ink" (default ink, underlined at rest, Darker Pink on hover). Close ✕: every dismiss is a tertiary icon-only size-xs button (on the presenter canvas a tertiary-deck or secondary-deck size-sm one, on the audience phone tertiary-deck md) — never hand-roll a ✕, never use antd's own notification or message close, never make it a circle, never resize it, and never put it in the middle of the box: it sits on the first line of text, in the corner. Size: LARGE (lg) is the default for most actions; step down to MEDIUM (md) or SMALL (sm) in denser/secondary regions to lower an action's information-hierarchy, not by whim. Size only via the size attribute (xs / sm / md / lg / xl / touch / inline) — never inline height/padding/radius/fontSize, and never through ::part(button). Recolour only by setting --aha-color-primary (plus the --aha-button-primary-* hover, press and text tokens) on the document root. Primary fill is #E70E68; hover #DB005B per DS V3.
opinion.dsv3: <aha-button> binds to a NAMED button semantic-token layer (--aha-button-*): --aha-button-primary-bg/-bg-hover/-bg-press/-text, --aha-button-default-bg/-text/-border/-bg-hover/-text-hover/-border-hover/-border-press, --aha-button-ghost-bg-hover/-bg-press (tertiary), --aha-button-positive-bg/-bg-hover/-bg-press/-text, --aha-button-disabled-bg/-text, --aha-button-focus-ring, --aha-button-elevate-primary/-primary-hover/-secondary. Three optional hooks default to no change: --aha-button-primary-border (the primary edge, default the fill colour) --aha-button-focus-outline (replaces the focus ring outline, default 2px solid var(--aha-button-focus-ring)), --aha-button-focus-outline-offset (default 2px) and --aha-button-primary-shortcut-bg (the primary's shortcut chip wash, default black 20%). The --aha-button-danger-* tokens and --aha-button-focus-ring-success still exist but <aha-button> no longer reads them: danger renders as secondary, and only <aha-dropdown> reads --aha-button-danger-bg. --aha-button-focus-gap is different: it is an override hook with no value in tokens.css, so the focus gap falls back to --aha-bg-base until a screen sets it. Every other token named above is a pure indirection whose value references the core DS token (e.g. --aha-button-primary-bg: var(--aha-color-primary)), so button theming can move independently of the core palette with NO visual change — the rendered colours are byte-identical to the raw --aha-btn-* seeds.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

options.label: Danger
options.note: Danger looks the same as Secondary on purpose: status carries no hue, so a destructive action is told apart by its label and a confirm step, not by colour.

options.label: Positive
options.note: Positive looks the same as Primary on purpose: status carries no hue, so it is Vivid Pink like Primary.

options.label: Primary alt
options.note: Primary alt looks the same as Primary on purpose: it is a synonym of Primary.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. Values are the component-standard measured target for btn|primary|md.

selfCheck.label: size inline in a sentence: 0 padding, no border, 21px line height, weight 400
text-link tone ink: #1A1A1A underlined at rest, #DB005B underlined on hover and press, no fill
shortcut chip 24 × 24 · radius 4 · 14px / 400 key · 8px from the label · aria-hidden
focus ring 2px solid #E70E68 outside a 2px gap, 4.51:1 on white
danger renders as secondary · positive Vivid Pink like primary
close ✕: tertiary icon-only xs · 20 × 20 · radius 6 · 16px system-x · never circular

canvas close ✕: tertiary-deck (secondary-deck directly on a photo deck's photo; tertiary-deck on a filled card over the photo when the glyph clears 3:1) icon-only sm · 28 × 28 · radius 4 · 16px system-x · glyph in the secondary deck ink at rest
audience close ✕: tertiary-deck icon-only md · 36 × 36 · 44 × 44 hit area · 16px system-x · muted grey on a sheet
